prerequisites: Successful completion of modules to be completed in the 1st and 2nd semesters according to the study plan.
Recommended: All courses from the first four semesters.

learning_outcomes.text: Students are able to solve a complex problem from the field of process engineering or mechanical engineering within one week together with a team.
Students are able to apply previously acquired subject-specific and methodological knowledge to a specific problem.
Students learn and train specific key competences in group work and presentations: project management, time management, organization.
Students learn and train specific key competences in group work and presentations: teamwork.
Students learn and train specific key competences in group work and presentations: presentation techniques.

syllabus_topics: Design and Optimization of Structural Components Project Seminar
Innovation and Development Management Project Seminar
Computer-Aided Design and Planning Project Seminar
Project Planning of Extrusion Plants Project Seminar
Engineers Without Borders Challenge Project Seminar
Sustainable Project Seminar in Control Engineering
Changing topics on practical application problems in mechanical engineering.
assessment_rules: The module completion examination consists of an oral examination lasting 30-45 minutes. The performance points are awarded if the module completion examination is passed.
